basics.name: Migon Choi
basics.label: Materials Scientist | AI for Materials & Autonomous Experimentation
basics.summary: Materials scientist working at the intersection of experimental science, machine learning, uncertainty-aware decision-making, and autonomous experimentation.

work.name: Duke University
highlights: Developing scientific data infrastructure and metadata systems for materials research and scholarly literature.
Working on schema design, materials classification, data quality evaluation, and scientific data pipelines.

work.name: Duke University
highlights: Developed machine-learning approaches for small, noisy, and heterogeneous experimental materials datasets.
Applied Bayesian modeling, uncertainty quantification, active learning, and interpretable machine learning to materials discovery and experimental decision-making.
Integrated computational modeling with experimental materials synthesis and characterization.

work.name: Duke Capital Partners
highlights: Evaluated science- and engineering-driven technologies through technical diligence and venture assessment.
Assessed technical risk, commercialization potential, and translation from academic research to industry.

work.name: Samsung Electronics
highlights: Worked on semiconductor process integration for 8/14 nm RF FinFET technologies at Samsung Foundry.
Collaborated across materials, CVD, photolithography, and device/process characterization.

work.name: Samsung Electronics
highlights: Completed an industry internship at Samsung Electronics prior to joining Samsung Foundry as a full-time engineer.

work.name: Korea Institute of Energy Research

work.name: Korea Institute of Geoscience and Mineral Resources
highlights: Conducted undergraduate research involving materials processing and resource recovery.
